statement:

  (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) →

        Continuous g' → ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f x * g' x = f b * g b - f a * g a - ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, f' x * g x
